description: Dept. of Elections - Vacated the office of member of the Ella P/S by Mr. Sihabdeen Mohamed Nilan. reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of the Ella Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling clearly under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including candidate registrations, vacancies, and electoral commission decisions.
